title: Easy Flaky Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: A delicious and easy to make Jamaican dish featuring chicken skewers with a malty and flaky texture, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This flexitarian-friendly recipe uses vanilla extract and is grilled to perfection on a robata-grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, malted milk powder, and a pinch of salt.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the flour mixture.
Thread the coated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with the soy sauce, brown sugar, and vanilla extract mixture.
Grill the skewers on the robata-grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush the skewers with the vegetable oil and sprinkle with chopped scallions.
Serve the skewers hot and enjoy.
Garnish with additional scallions if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
